# Rumors This guide will explain how rumors can be used to gain money, equipment and influence in Persistence. Rumors are a great source of income for all characters and gaining reputation with the Nations is a key element of character progression.
Information about rumors currently available to your character is accessed through the 'Rumors' tab of the [bold]Job Network Menu[/bold].
## What Rumors are
Rumors are jobs given to characters by the Nations that colonize the Thresholds. Completing these rumors will give the character money and reputation with the Nation it comes from.
As you gain reputation with the Nations they will send more rewarding rumors and you will unlock additional [bold]Rumored Imports[/bold] from that Nation.
For more information see the Rumored Imports guide.
## Gaining Rumors Characters gain a new rumor once every 60 minutes as long as they don't have 4 already. Rumors can be transfered between characters so they can be bought or sold.
Rumors with simple objectives will progress into more complex rumors when completed.
### Transfering Rumors Rumors are transfered with the 'Transfer' button on the rumor. The receiving character must not already have 4 rumors.
When a transfered rumor is completed [bold]the reputation reward is split 50% with the original owner of the rumor[/bold]. The character who completes the rumor still receives the full cash reward.
### Abandoning Rumors Rumors you don't want can be removed with the 'Abandon' button on the rumor.
## Rumor Rewards Completing a rumor gives a cash reward and reputation with the Nation that the rumor comes from.
[bold]Cash rewards are taxed by the sales tax of the faction you are working for[/bold]. The tax is deposited directly into that faction's account.
## Completing Rumors You can view the objective of the rumor through the Job Nework Menu.
### Eat/Drink Rumors These require the character [bold]travel to the specified station[/bold] and eat or drink something [bold]with the specified flavors[/bold].
Drinking will not work for an Eat requirement and eatng will not work for a Drink requirement.
### Pray/Reflect Rumors These require the character [bold]travel to the specified station[/bold] and [bold]pray or reflect using an altar[/bold].
Characters with an [bold]Insight[/bold] that makes them capable of using a bible are able to use that [bold]on the specified station[/bold] to complete the rumor.
### Bounty Rumors These require the character to use a cargo bounty computer to complete a bounty [bold]on the specified station[/bold] from the 'Rumors' tab of the bounty computer.
Only the character with the rumor can see the bounty on the cargo bounty computer, but anyone can do the actual exporting once the manifest is printed.
### Explore Rumors These require the character to travel [bold]to specific coordinates in space[/bold] where a nearby grid will spawn. The character who holds the rumor must approach the coordinates to trigger the grid to spawn.
Then the character who holds the rumor must [bold]board the new grid[/bold] to complete the rumor.
### Rescue Rumors These require the character to travel [bold]to specific coordinates in space[/bold] where a nearby grid will spawn. The character who holds the rumor must approach the coordinates to trigger the grid to spawn.
Then any humanoid NPCs aboard the grid must be [bold]brought to the specified station, healed and revived[/bold] to complete the rumor.
### Recharge Rumors These require the character to travel [bold]to specific coordinates in space[/bold] where a nearby grid will spawn. The character who holds the rumor must approach the coordinates to trigger the grid to spawn.
Then the [bold]specified machines on board the grid must be fully recharged[/bold] to complete the rumor.
### Exterminate Rumors These require the character to travel [bold]to specific coordinates in space[/bold] where a nearby grid will spawn. The character who holds the rumor must approach the coordinates to trigger the grid to spawn.
Then [bold]every hostile creature that arrived with the grid must be killed[/bold] to complete the rumor.
### Artifact Rumors These require the character to travel [bold]to specific coordinates in space[/bold] where a nearby grid will spawn. The character who holds the rumor must approach the coordinates to trigger the grid to spawn.
Then the [bold]xeno-artifacts found on the grid must have the specified number of nodes unlocked[/bold] to complete the rumor. The rumor shows how many nodes are left to unlock.
### Anomaly Rumors These require the character to travel [bold]to specific coordinates in space[/bold] where a nearby grid will spawn. The character who holds the rumor must approach the coordinates to trigger the grid to spawn.
Then the [bold]anomaly found on the grid must be brought to 90% stability[/bold] as shown on an anomaly scanner to complete the rumor.
### Mail Rumors These require the character to [bold]unlock a piece of mail addressed to them[/bold] which is delivered to the [bold]cargo pallets of the specified Trade Station[/bold].
[bold]If anyone other than the character who holds the rumor unlocks the mail the rumor will fail![/bold] Transfering a mail rumor will readdress the mail to the new owner.
## Rumor Grids Grids spawned by rumors are temporary. A rumor with temporary grids shows a timer, and [bold]when the timer runs out the grids disappear and the rumor expires[/bold]. Characters still aboard a rumor grid when it disappears will be left floating in space, and any items left on the grid will be lost.
Rumor grids cannot be claimed.
